create_file_insert: create a new file record in the database using insert_new_file with user_id and FileForm data
get_file_by_id: get a file record from the database by its unique id using get_file_by_id
search_files_glob: search files by glob filename pattern with user filter and pagination using search_files
update_file_data: update file data and metadata fields by id using update_file_by_id with FileUpdateForm
delete_file_by_id: delete a file record from the database by its id using delete_file_by_id
